title: 部门分组统计
objective: 按部门分组统计，再按组内人数筛选部门。
statement: 按 department_id 分组，统计每个部门的员工人数和月薪合计，只保留人数不少于 3 的部门，输出 department_id、employee_count、total_salary。3 人整也保留；空表没有分组结果。
knowledge: GROUP BY department_id 将同一部门的员工归为一组，结果每个部门最多一行；COUNT(*) 数组内员工，SUM(salary) 汇总组内月薪。
SELECT 中的 department_id 是分组标识；按编号分组不会把同名部门或员工姓名误合并。空表没有任何组，因此返回零行。
HAVING 在分组后按聚合结果筛组，COUNT(*) >= 3 包含三人边界。COUNT(*) 写在 WHERE 中不是“提前筛行”，SQLite 会因 WHERE 不能使用该聚合而报错。
starterSql: -- 按部门统计，只保留员工人数不少于 3 人的部门。

hints.text: 输出粒度是一行一个部门：先按 department_id 汇总，再按汇总后的人数保留部门。
GROUP BY department_id 形成部门组，HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 在聚合后筛选；WHERE 用于分组前的普通行条件。
SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS employee_count, SUM(salary) AS total_salary FROM employees GROUP BY ____ HAVING ____;

referenceSolutions.sql: SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS employee_count, SUM(salary) AS total_salary FROM employees GROUP BY department_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3;
referenceSolutions.explanation: GROUP BY 让每个 department_id 成为一组，分别计算人数和月薪合计；HAVING 在聚合完成后保留人数至少为三人的组。

expectedFailures.sql: SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS employee_count, SUM(salary) AS total_salary FROM employees GROUP BY department_id;
SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS employee_count, SUM(salary) AS total_salary FROM employees GROUP BY department_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 3;
SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS employee_count, SUM(salary) AS total_salary FROM employees GROUP BY department_id HAVING SUM(salary) >= 30000;
